lines.text: 숲속에 여우랑 두루미가 살았어요.
lines.en: In the forest lived a fox and a crane.
segs: In the forest lived a fox and a crane.

lines.text: 여우가 초대장을 가져왔어요. 초대장을 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Fox brought an invitation. Tap the invitation!
segs: Fox brought an invitation. Tap the invitation!

lines.text: 초대장을 톡 눌러서 두루미에게 줘요!
lines.en: Tap the invitation and give it to Crane!
segs: Tap the invitation and give it to Crane!

lines.text: "와, 고마워!" 두루미가 긴 다리로 폴짝 뛰었어요.
lines.en: "Wow, thank you!" Crane hopped up on those long legs.
segs: Crane hopped up on those long legs.

lines.text: 여우가 맛있는 수프를 끓여요.
lines.en: Fox is cooking some yummy soup.
segs: Fox is cooking some yummy soup.

lines.text: 냄비를 톡톡 눌러서 저어 볼까요?
lines.en: Shall we tap the pot and stir it?
segs: Shall we tap the pot and stir it?

lines.text: 냄비를 톡톡 눌러서 휘휘 저어요!
lines.en: Tap the pot and stir, stir, stir!
segs: Tap the pot and stir, stir, stir!

lines.text: 여우가 킥킥 웃어요. "납작 접시에 담아야지~"
lines.en: Fox giggles. "I'll serve it on a flat plate~"
segs: I'll serve it on a flat plate~

lines.text: 두루미가 놀러 왔어요. 그런데 접시가 아주 납작해요!
lines.en: Crane came to visit. But the plate is very flat!
segs: Crane came to visit. But the plate is very flat!

lines.text: 두루미 부리를 톡 눌러서 먹게 해 줘요!
lines.en: Tap Crane's beak to help Crane eat!
segs: Tap Crane's beak to help Crane eat!

lines.text: 두루미 부리를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Crane's beak!

lines.text: 어머나, 부리 끝만 딱딱 닿아요. 수프를 먹을 수가 없어요.
lines.en: Oh dear, only the tip of the beak goes clack, clack. Crane can't eat the soup.
segs: Oh dear, only the tip of the beak goes clack, clack. Crane can't eat the soup.

lines.text: 여우는 혀로 핥핥, 다 먹었어요. 두루미는 배가 꼬르륵, 속상했어요.
lines.en: Fox licked, lick lick, and ate it all up. Crane's tummy rumbled, and Crane felt sad.
segs: Fox licked, lick lick, and ate it all up. Crane's tummy rumbled, and Crane felt sad.

lines.text: 며칠 뒤, 이번엔 두루미가 여우를 불렀어요.
lines.en: A few days later, Crane invited Fox over.
segs: A few days later, Crane invited Fox over.

lines.text: "여우야, 우리 집에도 놀러 와~"
lines.en: "Fox, come over to my house too~"
segs: "Fox, come over to my house too~"

lines.text: 여우가 신이 났어요. "좋아! 맛있는 거 먹어야지!"
lines.en: Fox was so excited. "Yay! I'm going to eat something yummy!"
segs: Yay! I'm going to eat something yummy!

lines.text: 와, 병이 탑처럼 높아요! 목이 아주 길어요.
lines.en: Wow, the bottle is as tall as a tower! The neck is so long.
segs: Wow, the bottle is as tall as a tower!

lines.text: 여우 코를 톡 눌러서 먹게 해 줘요!
lines.en: Tap Fox's nose to help Fox eat!
segs: Tap Fox's nose to help Fox eat!

lines.text: 여우 코를 톡 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Fox's nose!

lines.text: 여우 코를 한 번 더 톡!
lines.en: Tap Fox's nose one more time!
segs: Tap Fox's nose one more time!

lines.text: 여우 코를 톡! 폴짝 뛰어 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Fox's nose! Let's hop!

lines.text: 어머나! 여우 코가 병에 쏙 끼었어요!
lines.en: Oh no! Fox's nose got stuck in the bottle!
segs: Oh no! Fox's nose got stuck in the bottle!

lines.text: 뿅! 코가 빠졌어요. 엉덩방아 쿵!
lines.en: Pop! The nose came out. Fox landed with a thump!
segs: Pop! The nose came out. Fox landed with a thump!

lines.text: 두루미는 긴 부리로 쪽쪽 먹었어요. 여우는 배가 꼬르륵, 속상했어요.
lines.en: Crane sipped with that long beak, sip, sip. Fox's tummy rumbled, and Fox felt sad.
segs: Crane sipped with that long beak, sip, sip. Fox's tummy rumbled, and Fox felt sad.

lines.text: 둘 다 못 먹었어요. 왜 그랬을까요?
lines.en: Neither of them could eat. Why was that?
segs: Neither of them could eat. Why was that?

lines.text: 두루미는 부리가 길쭉해요. 어떤 그릇이 좋을까요?
lines.en: Crane has a long, thin beak. Which dish is best?
segs: Crane has a long, thin beak. Which dish is best?

lines.text: 길쭉한 부리가 쏙 들어가는 그릇을 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Find the dish where a long beak fits right in!
segs: Find the dish where a long beak fits right in!

lines.text: 여우는 입이 짧아요. 혀로 핥아 먹어요. 어떤 그릇이 좋을까요?
lines.en: Fox has a short mouth and licks food up. Which dish is best?
segs: Fox has a short mouth and licks food up. Which dish is best?

lines.text: 혀로 핥기 좋은 납작한 그릇을 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Find a flat dish that's good for licking!
segs: Find a flat dish that's good for licking!

lines.text: 여우랑 두루미가 함께 잔치를 열었어요. 손님들도 와요!
lines.en: Fox and Crane are having a feast together. The guests are coming too!
segs: Fox and Crane are having a feast together. The guests are coming too!

lines.text: 입 모양을 잘 보고, 알맞은 그릇을 골라 줘요!
lines.en: Look at each mouth, and pick the right dish!
segs: Look at each mouth, and pick the right dish!

lines.text: 여우는 입이 짧아요. 어떤 그릇이 좋을까요?
lines.en: Fox has a short mouth. Which dish is best?
segs: Fox has a short mouth. Which dish is best?

lines.text: 오리는 부리가 넓적해요. 어떤 그릇이 좋을까요?
lines.en: Duck has a wide, flat beak. Which dish is best?
segs: Duck has a wide, flat beak. Which dish is best?

lines.text: 나비는 입이 빨대 같아요. 무엇이 좋을까요?
lines.en: Butterfly has a mouth like a straw. What is best?
segs: Butterfly has a mouth like a straw. What is best?

lines.text: 길쭉한 부리가 쏙 들어가는 걸 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Find the one where a long beak fits right in!
segs: Find the one where a long beak fits right in!

lines.text: 혀로 핥기 좋은 납작한 걸 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Find a flat one that's good for licking!
segs: Find a flat one that's good for licking!

lines.text: 넓적한 부리로 푹 떠먹기 좋은 걸 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Find one that's good for scooping with a wide beak!
segs: Find one that's good for scooping with a wide beak!

lines.text: 빨대 입으로 쪽 빨아 먹는 걸 찾아봐요!
lines.en: Find one to sip from with a straw mouth!
segs: Find one to sip from with a straw mouth!

lines.text: 두루미가 왔어요!
lines.en: Crane is here!

lines.text: 여우가 왔어요!
lines.en: Fox is here!

lines.text: 오리가 왔어요!
lines.en: Duck is here!

lines.text: 나비가 왔어요!
lines.en: Butterfly is here!

lines.text: 납작 접시예요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's the flat plate! Tap the sparkly one!
segs: It's the flat plate! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 긴 병이에요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's the tall bottle! Tap the sparkly one!
segs: It's the tall bottle! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 넓은 그릇이에요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's the wide bowl! Tap the sparkly one!
segs: It's the wide bowl! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 꽃이에요! 반짝이는 걸 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: It's the flower! Tap the sparkly one!
segs: It's the flower! Tap the sparkly one!

lines.text: 맞아요! 두루미는 긴 병이 좋아요.
lines.en: That's right! Crane likes the tall bottle.
segs: That's right! Crane likes the tall bottle.

lines.text: 맞아요! 여우는 납작 접시가 좋아요.
lines.en: That's right! Fox likes the flat plate.
segs: That's right! Fox likes the flat plate.

lines.text: 맞아요! 오리는 넓은 그릇이 좋아요.
lines.en: That's right! Duck likes the wide bowl.
segs: That's right! Duck likes the wide bowl.

lines.text: 맞아요! 나비는 꽃이 좋아요.
lines.en: That's right! Butterfly likes the flower.
segs: That's right! Butterfly likes the flower.

lines.text: 등불이 반짝, 모두 모여 잔치를 해요.
lines.en: The lanterns twinkle, and everyone gathers for the feast.
segs: The lanterns twinkle, and everyone gathers for the feast.

lines.text: 여우가 말했어요. "두루미야, 미안해."
lines.en: Fox said, "I'm sorry, Crane."

lines.text: 두루미도 말했어요. "여우야, 나도 미안해."
lines.en: Crane said, "I'm sorry too, Fox."

lines.text: "괜찮아!" 둘은 다시 사이좋은 친구가 되었어요.
lines.en: "It's okay!" The two became good friends again.
segs: The two became good friends again.

lines.text: 친구들을 톡톡 눌러 봐요. 냠냠 맛있게 먹어요!
lines.en: Tap your friends. Eat up, nom nom, yummy!
segs: Tap your friends. Eat up, nom nom, yummy!

lines.text: 배부르게 먹고, 모두 행복하게 웃었답니다.
lines.en: They ate until they were full, and everyone smiled happily.
segs: They ate until they were full, and everyone smiled happily.

cut_peck: Oh dear, my beak won't reach!
Crane pecks at the flat plate, but only the tip of the beak goes clack, clack.
cut_stuck: Fox's nose got stuck in the mouth of the tall bottle.

ui.누구에게 어떤 그릇이 좋을까?: Which dish is best for whom?
ui.친구 입장이 되어 보면 모두 즐거워요!: Thinking about a friend's needs makes everyone happy!
